Definition: Whether the system enables Know Your Customer (KYC) packet collection for service provision, particularly financial services
Comments: KYC is fully enabled via the National Identity Card. The Bank of Mauritius, Civil Status Division, Mauritius Police Force and MTCI signed MOUs for a Central KYC database via InfoHighway. Banks (e.g. MauBank) require NIC for customer onboarding. ICTA SIM Registration Regulations 2023 mandate NIC for SIM registration KYC. Smile ID provides digital KYC verification using NIC. MauPass e-KYC uses Acuant to compare selfies against NIC document photo.

Definition: Whether the civil registration and digital ID systems are integrated
Comments: Full integration. Mauritius has 100% civil registration coverage. A National Identity Number (NIN) is automatically computer-generated at birth registration (when at least one parent is Mauritian) and printed on the birth certificate. The same NIN is used on the national ID card at age 18, marriage certificates, and death deactivation — a complete lifecycle integration. The Civil Status Division manages both the CRVS and MNIC under the Prime Minister's Office, and data is shared via the Central Population Database and InfoHighway.

Definition: Whether procedural rules for collection, storage, and sharing of ID-related personal data are publicly available and established
Comments: Fully available data sharing rules. The Data Protection Act 2017 (Section 3(4)(a)) permits inter-agency data exchange on a need-to-know basis. The Digital Government Transformation Strategy and National Open Data Policy formalise data reuse. The InfoHighway platform requires MOUs/application forms, High-Level Management Team approval (chaired by MTCI), and data encryption for all 169 inter-agency connections. The Central KYC initiative (Bank of Mauritius, Civil Status Division, Police, MTCI) further governs financial ID data sharing.

Definition: Whether national data protection legislation exists and covers personal data linked to the ID system
Comments: The Data Protection Act 2017 (DPA 2017) came into force on 15 January 2018, repealing the 2004 Act. It aligns with EU GDPR principles, covers biometric data as a special category, mandates data controllers/processors to register, provides data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure), and requires 72-hour breach notification. Section 12 of the NIC Act explicitly subjects all MNIC data collection to the DPA.

Definition: Whether a Data Protection Authority or similar body regulates ID data collection and sharing by the ID system
Comments: The Data Protection Office (DPO), headed by the Data Protection Commissioner, is the independent supervisory authority under the DPA 2017. It is under the aegis of the Ministry of Technology, Communication and Innovation but is fully independent operationally. It has powers to investigate complaints, conduct audits, issue enforcement notices, and oversee data protection compliance. The Data Protection Commissioner has publicly commented on compliance requirements for MNIC 3.0 and Mobile ID.

Definition: Whether the digital ID system is designed to be interoperable across government agencies and with other systems through APIs or data exchange protocols
Comments: The MNIC system is interoperable with other government systems via the InfoHighway platform, which connects 169 government agency connections (as of 2023). The Central Population Database (CPD), managed by the Civil Status Division, shares data with MRA, Ministry of Social Security, Bank of Mauritius (Central KYC), and other agencies. MauPass (launched 2020) uses CPD for citizen authentication across hundreds of e-services.

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for opening bank accounts and accessing financial services
Comments: NIC use for banking is mandatory (for Mauritian citizens). Banks require the NIC for customer onboarding KYC. MauBank explicitly states that during customer onboarding, Mauritian nationals must use their National Identity Card (passport cannot substitute). The Central KYC database (Bank of Mauritius/Civil Status Division/MTCI MOU) further entrenches mandatory NIC-based KYC for financial services. The NIC number is required for National Savings Fund contribution records.

Definition: Percentage of eligible population that has been issued or registered with digital ID credentials
Comments: Coverage exceeds 89% of the eligible population (citizens aged 18+). By June 2019, 1,666,808 Smart National Identity Cards had been issued, and enrollment is mandatory for all citizens 18+. Total population is ~1.27M (2024). As virtually all adult citizens are legally required to hold a card and the system has been operational since 2013, coverage of the eligible (18+) population is effectively >89%. A mobile team serves bedridden/disabled citizens for registration.

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for SIM card activation and mobile service registration
Comments: NIC is mandatory for SIM card registration. The ICTA (Registration of SIM) Regulations 2023 (effective 31 October 2023) mandate that all SIM holders register using their NIC (or passport for non-citizens). All existing SIM holders had to re-register by 30 April 2024. Operators (my.t, Emtel, Chili) verify NIC photo against the applicant's photograph. Failure to register leads to SIM deactivation.
